acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-01: `POST /api/todos` with a valid title returns `201` and the created item with a UUIDv7 `id`, the trimmed `title`, `notes` (or `null`), `completed: false`, and ISO-8601 timestamps, and the row exists in `todo_item`.

verification.definingInputProperty: POST bodies with a padded title, and with notes
verification.assertions: 201; UUIDv7 id; trimmed title; notes or null; completed false; ISO timestamps; stored row matches
verification.observedResult: 2 passed | 25 skipped (27) (the skipped tests are the ones outside this -t filter, not skipped tests; the full-suite inventory run reports 0 skipped)

verification.definingInputProperty: A stored todo_item row with known values
verification.assertions: Row maps to TodoItem with ISO timestamps and storage-only columns dropped

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-02: `POST /api/todos` with a missing, empty, whitespace-only, or longer-than-200-character title returns `400` and writes no row.

verification.definingInputProperty: Missing, empty, whitespace-only, 201-character, and non-string titles; plus a 200-character boundary title
verification.assertions: Each invalid body gets 400 and zero rows are created; exactly 200 characters is accepted
verification.observedResult: 6 passed | 21 skipped (27) (the skipped tests are the ones outside this -t filter, not skipped tests; the full-suite inventory run reports 0 skipped)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-03: `GET /api/todos` returns every non-deleted item ordered oldest first, and `GET /api/todos/:id` returns that one item.

verification.definingInputProperty: Two live items created in order and one soft-deleted item
verification.assertions: List contains both live items oldest first and omits the deleted one; get by id returns the item
verification.observedResult: 2 passed | 25 skipped (27) (the skipped tests are the ones outside this -t filter, not skipped tests; the full-suite inventory run reports 0 skipped)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-04: `PATCH /api/todos/:id` changes only the supplied fields (`title`, `notes`, `completed`), leaves the others unchanged, advances `updatedTimestamp`, and returns the updated item, and an invalid title returns `400` and changes nothing.

verification.definingInputProperty: PATCH bodies supplying only completed; title plus notes:null; and an invalid title
verification.assertions: Only supplied fields change; updatedTimestamp advances; invalid title gets 400 with the row and updated_timestamp untouched
verification.observedResult: 3 passed | 24 skipped (27) (the skipped tests are the ones outside this -t filter, not skipped tests; the full-suite inventory run reports 0 skipped)

verification.definingInputProperty: applyTodoUpdate with empty, partial, null-notes, and full requests
verification.assertions: Unsupplied fields kept; null clears notes; id and timestamps never change

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-05: `DELETE /api/todos/:id` returns `204`, sets `deleted_timestamp` on the row without removing it, and the item no longer appears in the list or in a get by id.

verification.definingInputProperty: A live item deleted through the API
verification.assertions: 204 with empty body; row still exists with deleted_timestamp set; absent from list; get returns 404
verification.observedResult: 1 passed | 26 skipped (27) (the skipped tests are the ones outside this -t filter, not skipped tests; the full-suite inventory run reports 0 skipped)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-06: `GET`, `PATCH`, or `DELETE` for an id that does not exist or is already deleted returns `404` with a `TodoNotFound` body, and a malformed id returns `400`.

verification.definingInputProperty: A random unknown UUID, an already-deleted id, and the malformed id 'not-a-uuid' on GET, PATCH, and DELETE
verification.assertions: 404 with {_tag: TodoNotFound, id} for unknown and deleted ids; 400 for the malformed id
verification.observedResult: 7 passed | 20 skipped (27) (the skipped tests are the ones outside this -t filter, not skipped tests; the full-suite inventory run reports 0 skipped)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-07: A `POST`, `PATCH`, or `DELETE` request without an `x-csrf-token` header matching the `csrf_token` cookie returns `403` and changes nothing, and `GET /api/csrf` issues that token.

verification.definingInputProperty: POST, PATCH, and DELETE with no token, cookie only, and a mismatched header
verification.assertions: All 403 CsrfRejected; target row unchanged and no row created; reads allowed; /api/csrf issues an HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie and reuses a valid one
verification.observedResult: 5 passed | 22 skipped (27) (the skipped tests are the ones outside this -t filter, not skipped tests; the full-suite inventory run reports 0 skipped)

verification.definingInputProperty: Matching, missing, different, malformed, and empty token pairs
verification.assertions: Only identical well-formed tokens match; only state-changing methods require a token

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-08: Integration tests run against a real PostgreSQL 18 database through a real HTTP server, create their data through a fixture provider registered with a `FixtureManager`, and clean up only the rows they created, by id.

verification.definingInputProperty: A bystander row from another fixture manager next to a temporary row
verification.assertions: cleanUp removes only the temporary row by id; the bystander survives
verification.observedResult: 1 passed | 26 skipped (27) (the skipped tests are the ones outside this -t filter, not skipped tests; the full-suite inventory run reports 0 skipped)

verification.command: pnpm --filter @todo/api test && psql postgres://todo:todo@localhost:5432/todo_test -tAc "select count(*) from todo_item" | grep -qx 0
verification.definingInputProperty: The full API suite run against the shared todo_test database
verification.assertions: Every row the suite created is gone afterwards (count is 0)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-09: Log output is JSON from the default winston logger and every line carries an `env` field read from `ENV`.

verification.assertions: Output lines are JSON with env=qa and annotations; unset defaults to local; invalid ENV is rejected
